mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HC_api_token ( user_id, access_token, token_type, expires_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{access_token}, #{token_type}, #{access_token_token_expired}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_token = VALUES(access_token), token_type = VALUES(token_type), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), updated_at = NOW()
